items.author: Law Murray 📘

Asked Quentin Grimes about balancing offensive responsibilities

"I know we got two of the best on-ball players in the game. So just being able to play off-ball, and also JJ wants guys who can pass, dribble, and shoot. And I feel like we have a lot of guys on this team that can do that."
